texts.HintSkillInteractionDetail: Left-click: +1 · Right-click: −1 · Clicking a higher-tier skill automatically increases the planned tree level and badge requirement. Ultimate requires tree level 50 with seven regular badges and one Ultimate Badge. Ways still require eleven invested branch points. Tree colors by minimum character level: White ≤20 · Blue ≤40 · Purple ≤60 · Gold >60 · Keyboard: Enter / Space +1, Minus / Delete −1. Skill information is shown on hover or focus.

texts.RulePerkProgression: One perk point at character level 10, then at 15, 20, 25, etc. Three ranks per perk; bonuses are additive. Rank 1: observed in-game. Ranks 2 and 3: estimated. You can plan beyond your current allocation; the overview accounts for the required character level.
texts.RulePerkStacking: The percentage bonuses are cumulative per perk. Their interaction with equipment, skill effects, and other character attributes has not yet been modeled.

texts.PatchDataStatus: Verification against 0.7.0.1: the damage reference for the six Best Weapon DPS skills has been corrected to best base weapon DPS. Skill rank values confirmed by the player remain unchanged. Unverified ranged accuracy values are not confirmed new patch values. The new character XP curve from level 20 does not establish a change to badge or perk point distribution.
texts.PatchCombatRules: Game patch 0.7.0.0: damage bonuses add within the same keyword bucket and multiply between buckets. This planner does not calculate complete combat damage. Bleeding, fire and poison bypass shields. Accuracy affects spread and camera recoil; the old recoil stat has been removed. Weapon specials are separate: all shotguns have Scattershot (projectiles spread in a cone) and knockback against NPCs; swords have Riposte and Momentum. Skills based on active weapon DPS use the Character Menu value with the required weapon drawn, rather than the item tooltip DPS. Check buffs in the Character Menu.
texts.RuleBestWeaponDpsDetail: Since 0.7.0.1, Titan Turret, Fungal Fallout, Battlefield Bulwark, Electric Field, Overcharge and Anarchist’s Revolution use the highest base DPS of the character’s weapons. Weapon-specific bonuses such as backstab, critical damage and weapon identity damage do not apply. This is a different reference from boosted active weapon DPS.
texts.SourcePlannerCredits: Unofficial community planner for Persist Online. Based on Skill Planner 1.0 by Avalon [Westwood] (NA), 2026-05-05; current skill values from in-game tooltips and observations from October 2026. The game is in development and values may change.
texts.RuleBadgeProgression: Starting at character level 10, each level grants one regular badge. At levels 45, 55, 65, 75, and 85, an Ultimate Badge is granted instead. Silver stars represent regular badges, gold stars represent Ultimate Badges. Each regular badge extends a tree by five levels from 10 to 45; an Ultimate Badge unlocks levels 46–50. Tree XP must be earned independently of character level.
texts.NoteTreeLevelUnlock: You don't have to spend points in a tree to unlock higher-tier skills. It is possible to level a tree to 50 without spending any skill points. Badges increase the tree level independently of point allocation. However, you must invest points in the respective skills to unlock Way switches and receive their bonuses.
texts.RuleTierUnlockCounting: Unlocks depend on tree level: T2 and its corresponding passive at 16, T3 and its corresponding passive at 31, and Ultimate at 50. No allocated skill points are required.
texts.RuleLevelLock: With 'Limit to character level' enabled, badge and perk spending is restricted to the selected character level. Without the lock, you can freely plan ahead; the required character level is displayed. A plan that already exceeds the limit must be reduced before enabling the lock or the character level must be increased.
texts.RulePlanAndReset: Each tree level grants one skill point. Refunding skill points automatically reduces the planned tree level and badge requirement to the level needed by the remaining skills. You can also plan the tree level independently of point allocation using the selector at the skill tree. Since game patch 0.7.0.0, Amnesia Pills can also refund badges invested in the selected skill tree. Automatic reductions here describe planning, not the complete in-game reset process.
texts.RuleEnhancersAndWays: Enhancers require the base skill. A Way requires eleven invested points in the associated horizontal skill branch and itself costs one point. One Way can be selected per ability. Action bars provide ten slots plus ten alternate slots; weapon-dependent loadouts are not yet simulated here.
texts.HintLanguagePacks: You can create custom language packs: export the selected language as a JSON file, translate the values under “texts”, and keep the keys and placeholders unchanged. For a new language, change “code” and “label”. Load the file here to add it to the language menu.

texts.SkillConstructionT2WayUNBOUNDDesc: Ignores all negative movement speed effects caused by movement-reducing debuffs.
texts.SkillConstructionT2WayUNFADINGDesc: +10 seconds status effect duration; 25 seconds total.
texts.SkillConstructionT3Desc: Creates a tar puddle. Players and non-player targets entering the area are afflicted with Paralysis (3 s) until they leave the area. Ignores debuff immunity after Paralysis expires. Each application of Paralysis to a player or non-player target consumes one charge.
texts.SkillConstructionT3EffectiveDesc: Creates a tar puddle. Players and non-player targets entering the area are afflicted with Paralysis (3 s) until they leave the area. Ignores debuff immunity after Paralysis expires. Each application of Paralysis to a player or non-player target consumes one charge. Puddle duration: {effect0} s.
texts.SkillConstructionT3WaySURVIVALISTDesc: Doubles the number of charges: 20 to 40.
texts.SkillConstructionUltDesc: Creates a barricade with rank-dependent HP. Deals rank-dependent damage based on best base weapon DPS and applies Paralysis to players and non-player targets in front of it. Since 0.7.0.1, damage uses the highest base DPS across primary and secondary weapons; weapon-specific bonuses such as backstab, critical damage and weapon identity damage do not apply.
texts.SkillMiningP4Desc: While crouching. The recoil stat was removed in 0.7.0.0; possible accuracy value changes have not yet been verified.
texts.SkillMiningT1Desc: Attack against all nearby targets; initially deals 150% active weapon DPS.
texts.SkillMiningT1EffectiveDesc: Attack against all nearby targets; initially deals {effect0}% active weapon DPS.
texts.SkillMiningT1WayGHOSTDesc: Grants +30% dodge for 3 seconds. Dodge: chance to completely negate damage from all attacks except abilities.
texts.SkillMiningT2Desc: Removes all physical debuffs and heals 25% of missing HP.
texts.SkillMiningT2EffectiveDesc: Removes all physical debuffs and heals {effect0}% of missing HP.
texts.SkillMiningT2WayPHYSICIANDesc: Also removes physical debuffs from group members within 20 m.
texts.SkillMiningT2WayNURTURERDesc: Also heals group members within 20 m.
texts.SkillMiningT3Desc: For 7 s, gain +50% melee weapon damage. Melee weapon hits cause Bleeding for 20 s.
texts.SkillMiningT3EffectiveDesc: For {effect0} s, gain +50% melee weapon damage. Melee weapon hits cause Bleeding for 20 s.
texts.SkillMiningUltName: A Hard Day in the Mine
texts.SkillMiningUltDesc: During the status effect, using skills costs no stamina.
texts.SkillBotanyP4Desc: After a debuff expires naturally, increases critical damage for 8 s; stacks up to ten times. Refresh behavior for individual stacks is not specified.
texts.SkillBotanyP5Desc: Increased chance for your own buffs and status effects to gain +20% duration when applied. Rank increases the chance, not the duration bonus itself.
texts.SkillBotanyT1Desc: Blocks the next incoming mental debuff for an initial 15 s. The effect ends once a mental debuff has been blocked.
texts.SkillBotanyT1EffectiveDesc: Blocks the next incoming mental debuff for an initial {effect0} s. The effect ends once a mental debuff has been blocked.
texts.SkillBotanyT2Desc: Deals no damage; all targets in range are Blinded (3 s).
texts.SkillBotanyT2EffectiveDesc: Deals no damage; all targets in range are Blinded (3 s). Range: {effect0} m.
texts.SkillBotanyT2WaySTAGGERERDesc: Hit inflicts Dazed (3 s) and Traumatized (3 s).
texts.SkillBotanyT2WaySTRATEGISTDesc: −5 s cooldown per blinded target; can reduce cooldown to 0.
texts.SkillBotanyT3Desc: Requires an active melee weapon. Single-target attack: deals 100% active weapon DPS; hit applies Poisoned for 10 s. Base: 85 stamina, 150 s cooldown.
texts.SkillBotanyT3EffectiveDesc: Requires an active melee weapon. Single-target attack: deals {effect0}% active weapon DPS; hit applies Poisoned for 10 s. Base: 85 stamina, 150 s cooldown.
texts.SkillBotanyT3WayREAPERDesc: Instead hits all targets within melee range.
texts.SkillBotanyUltDesc: Creates a spore cloud within a 5 m radius. Spores follow you for 8 s and hit all targets every second, dealing damage and applying Confused and Distracted. Since 0.7.0.1, damage uses the highest base DPS across primary and secondary weapons; weapon-specific bonuses such as backstab, critical damage and weapon identity damage do not apply.
texts.SkillThieveryP1Desc: Increases the chance of additional loot when harvesting with lockpicks.
texts.SkillThieveryP2Desc: Increases gathering speed when harvesting with lockpicks.
texts.SkillThieveryP3Desc: Reduces durability loss when harvesting with lockpicks.
texts.SkillThieveryP4Desc: Increases climbing speed and jump height.
texts.SkillThieveryP5Desc: Requires an active ranged weapon. Increases shooting accuracy.
texts.SkillThieveryT1Desc: Marks all harvestable objects in the area and makes them easier to spot, even through walls, cover, or obstacles. Base duration: 10 s; base cost: 65 AP (stamina).
texts.SkillThieveryT1EffectiveDesc: Marks all harvestable objects in the area and makes them easier to spot, even through walls, cover, or obstacles. Base duration: {effect0} s; base cost: 65 AP (stamina).
texts.SkillThieveryT1Way1Desc: Doubles the values of all tool perks. The tooltip does not specify exactly which tool perks are affected.
texts.SkillThieveryT1Way2Desc: An icon indicates the type of harvestable object.
texts.SkillThieveryT2Desc: Grants +25% movement speed for 10 s. Does not stack with Haste.
texts.SkillThieveryT2EffectiveDesc: Grants +{effect0}% movement speed for 10 s. Does not stack with Haste.
texts.SkillThieveryT2Way1Desc: Ignores all negative movement speed effects caused by movement-reducing debuffs.
texts.SkillThieveryT2Way2Desc: Extends the status effect by 5 s (base 10 s, total 15 s).
texts.SkillThieveryT3Desc: Single-target melee attack. Deals no damage. Hit applies Stunned (5 s); on hit, you gain Haste (2 s).
texts.SkillThieveryT3EffectiveDesc: Single-target melee attack. Deals no damage. Hit applies Stunned (5 s); on hit, you gain Haste ({effect0} s).
texts.SkillThieveryT3Way1Desc: After Stunned is removed, Dazed is applied for 5 s.
texts.SkillThieveryT3Way2Desc: Hit applies Poisoned for 10 s. Extended general poison scaling: after 2/4/6/8/10/12 s, deals 10/7/4/3/2/1% of the target's maximum HP respectively. This general explanation extends beyond the skill duration; do not derive a total damage value from it.
texts.SkillThieveryUltDesc: Creates a sentry. A status effect displays the number of other human players within 5 m of the sentry. These players remain visible through obstacles while inside the area and, after leaving for a rank-dependent duration (see rank values). The status cannot be neutralized. The sentry disappears after 1200 s, upon logout, or when entering the bunker. Only one personal sentry may exist at a time; creating a new one removes the oldest. Damage-modifying effects do not affect it.
texts.SkillElectronicsP1Desc: Increases the chance of additional loot when harvesting with screwdrivers.
texts.SkillElectronicsP2Desc: Increases gathering speed when harvesting with screwdrivers.
texts.SkillElectronicsP3Desc: Reduces durability loss when harvesting with screwdrivers.
texts.SkillElectronicsP4Desc: When hit by a melee attack, you deal damage based on your best base weapon DPS to the attacker. This damage cannot be dodged or reduced. Can trigger at most once every 5 s. Since 0.7.0.1, damage uses the highest base DPS across primary and secondary weapons; weapon-specific bonuses such as backstab, critical damage and weapon identity damage do not apply.
texts.SkillElectronicsP5Desc: Increases the chance to extend the duration of mental and physical debuffs you apply by 20%. Rank affects the chance, not the extension amount.
texts.SkillElectronicsT1Desc: Requires an active ranged weapon. On the next hit: initially +150% weapon damage based on active weapon DPS and Disgusted for 4 s. Base cost: 65 stamina; base cooldown: 50 s.
texts.SkillElectronicsT1EffectiveDesc: Requires an active ranged weapon. On the next hit: initially +{effect0}% weapon damage based on active weapon DPS and Disgusted for 4 s. Base cost: 65 stamina; base cooldown: 50 s.
texts.SkillElectronicsT1ImpactDesc: Improves additional damage based on active weapon DPS.
texts.SkillElectronicsT1Way1Desc: Extends Disgusted by 2 s (base 4 s, total 6 s).
texts.SkillElectronicsT2Desc: Creates a MedPulse Unit. Every second, a pulse heals you and group or guild members within 5 m for an initial 2.5% of maximum HP. The unit has 10% of your maximum HP and disappears after 10 s. Base cost: 75 stamina; base cooldown: 180 s.
texts.SkillElectronicsT2EffectiveDesc: Creates a MedPulse Unit. Every second, a pulse heals you and group or guild members within 5 m for an initial {effect0}% of maximum HP. The unit has 10% of your maximum HP and disappears after 10 s. Base cost: 75 stamina; base cooldown: 180 s.
texts.SkillElectronicsT2ImpactDesc: Improves healing based on maximum HP per pulse.
texts.SkillElectronicsT2Way1Desc: Extends the MedPulse Unit's lifetime by 10 s (base 10 s, total 20 s).
texts.SkillElectronicsT2Way2Desc: If destroyed by an enemy, the unit heals 25% maximum HP of all group and guild members within 5 m, including yourself.
texts.SkillElectronicsT3Desc: Grants a status effect for 20 s: players and non-player targets in the area are marked and easier to see, even through walls, cover, or obstacles.
texts.SkillElectronicsT3EffectiveDesc: Grants a status effect for {effect0} s: players and non-player targets in the area are marked and easier to see, even through walls, cover, or obstacles.
texts.SkillElectronicsT3Way1Desc: Extends the status effect duration by 20 s.
texts.SkillElectronicsUltDesc: Attack against all nearby targets. Deals damage based on the highest DPS value of your primary and secondary weapon and applies Blinded and Disgusted. Since 0.7.0.1, damage uses the highest base DPS across primary and secondary weapons; weapon-specific bonuses such as backstab, critical damage and weapon identity damage do not apply.
texts.SkillWoodworkingP1Desc: Increases the chance of additional loot when harvesting with axes.
texts.SkillWoodworkingP2Desc: Increases gathering speed when harvesting with axes.
texts.SkillWoodworkingP3Desc: Reduces durability loss when harvesting with axes.
texts.SkillWoodworkingT1Desc: Requires an active melee weapon. Attack against all nearby targets: initially grants 100% bonus damage based on active weapon DPS and applies Bleeding for 10 s. Base cost: 65 stamina; base cooldown: 50 s.
texts.SkillWoodworkingT1EffectiveDesc: Requires an active melee weapon. Attack against all nearby targets: initially grants {effect0}% bonus damage based on active weapon DPS and applies Bleeding for 10 s. Base cost: 65 stamina; base cooldown: 50 s.
texts.SkillWoodworkingT1ImpactDesc: Improves damage based on active weapon DPS.
texts.SkillWoodworkingT1Way1Desc: Extends Bleeding by 10 s (base 10 s, total 20 s).
texts.SkillWoodworkingT1Way2Desc: +100% critical chance. The exact interaction with other critical chance modifiers cannot be determined from the tooltip.
texts.SkillWoodworkingT2Desc: Removes all mental debuffs from yourself. Grants a status effect for 5 s that blocks the next incoming mental debuff. Can also be used while affected by a debuff that would prevent skill usage.
texts.SkillWoodworkingT2EffectiveDesc: Removes all mental debuffs from yourself. Grants a status effect for {effect0} s that blocks the next incoming mental debuff. Can also be used while affected by a debuff that would prevent skill usage.
texts.SkillWoodworkingT2Way1Desc: Also removes all mental debuffs from nearby group members. No specific range is given in the tooltip.
texts.SkillWoodworkingT2Way2Desc: Also applies the status effect to nearby group members. No specific range is given in the tooltip.
texts.SkillWoodworkingT3Way1Desc: Extends the status effect by 2 s (base 6 s, total 8 s).
texts.SkillWoodworkingT3Way2Desc: On hit: removes the target's shield.
texts.SkillWoodworkingUltDesc: Reduces the cooldowns of all active abilities by the number of seconds shown in the rank values. Not a percentage reduction.
texts.SkillHuntingP1Desc: Increases the chance of additional loot when harvesting with knives.
texts.SkillHuntingP2Desc: Increases gathering speed when harvesting with knives.
texts.SkillHuntingP3Desc: Reduces durability loss when harvesting with knives.
texts.SkillHuntingP5Desc: Requires an active ranged weapon and a position outside the target's line of sight. Increases critical hit chance and critical damage.
texts.SkillHuntingT1Desc: Requires an active mental debuff. Removes the most recent mental debuff and grants +30% damage for 4 s. Can also be used while affected by a debuff that would prevent skill usage.
texts.SkillHuntingT1EffectiveDesc: Requires an active mental debuff. Removes the most recent mental debuff and grants +{effect0}% damage for 4 s. Can also be used while affected by a debuff that would prevent skill usage.
texts.SkillHuntingT1Way2Desc: Extends the status effect by 2 s (base 4 s, total 6 s).
texts.SkillHuntingT2Desc: Requires an active ranged weapon. Grants +25% critical chance for 6 s.
texts.SkillHuntingT2EffectiveDesc: Requires an active ranged weapon. Grants +{effect0}% critical chance for 6 s.
texts.SkillHuntingT2Way2Desc: Extends the status effect by 3 s (base 6 s, total 9 s).
texts.SkillHuntingT3Desc: Attack against all targets within 5 m. Deals no damage; applies Stunned for 3 s.
texts.SkillHuntingT3EffectiveDesc: Attack against all targets within {effect0} m. Deals no damage; applies Stunned for 3 s.
texts.SkillHuntingUltDesc: Creates a mine that explodes when other players or non-player targets come too close. Hits all targets in the area except the owner and their group and guild members. Deals damage based on the target's maximum HP and applies Stunned for 3 s. Lifetime depends on rank (see rank values); also disappears when logging out or entering the bunker. Only one personal mine may exist at a time; placing a new one removes the oldest. Damage-modifying effects do not affect it.
texts.SkillMechanicsP1Desc: Increases the chance of additional loot when harvesting with wrenches.
texts.SkillMechanicsP2Desc: Increases gathering speed when harvesting with wrenches.
texts.SkillMechanicsP3Desc: Reduces durability loss when harvesting with wrenches.
texts.SkillMechanicsP4Desc: Increases resistance. The exact calculation of this value is not explained in the displayed tooltip.
texts.SkillMechanicsP5Desc: Increases the chance that mental and physical debuffs received have their duration reduced by 20%. Rank values affect the chance, not the amount of duration reduction.
texts.SkillMechanicsT1Desc: Grants a status effect for 4 s: hits initially have a 25% chance to apply Paralysis for 2 s, provided the target is not already Paralyzed.
texts.SkillMechanicsT1EffectiveDesc: Grants a status effect for 4 s: hits initially have a {effect0}% chance to apply Paralysis for 2 s, provided the target is not already Paralyzed.
texts.SkillMechanicsT1Way1Desc: Extends Paralysis by 2 s (base 2 s, total 4 s).
texts.SkillMechanicsT1Way2Desc: Extends the status effect by 4 s (base 4 s, total 8 s).
texts.SkillMechanicsT2Desc: Creates a stationary, invulnerable Distracting Robot. Taunts all non-player targets within 10 m and pacifies all targets currently aggroed on you. Disappears after 5 s.
texts.SkillMechanicsT2EffectiveDesc: Creates a stationary, invulnerable Distracting Robot. Taunts all non-player targets within 10 m and pacifies all targets currently aggroed on you. Disappears after {effect0} s.
texts.SkillMechanicsT2Way1Desc: When the Decoy Robot disappears, it applies Crippled for 4 s to all targets within range.
texts.SkillMechanicsT2Way2Desc: When the Decoy Robot disappears, it applies Vulnerable for 4 s to all targets within range.
texts.SkillMechanicsT3Desc: On the next hit: applies Confused for 3 s, Dazed for 3 s, and Blinded for 2 s. No additional weapon requirement is mentioned in the displayed tooltip.
texts.SkillMechanicsT3EffectiveDesc: On the next hit: applies Confused for 3 s, Dazed for {effect1} s, and Blinded for {effect0} s. No additional weapon requirement is mentioned in the displayed tooltip.
texts.SkillMechanicsT3ImpactDesc: Alternately improves Blinded and Dazed duration. Rank values show both simultaneous durations at each rank.
texts.SkillMechanicsT3Way1Desc: Extends Confused by 3 s (base 3 s, total 6 s).
texts.SkillMechanicsT3Way2Desc: Refunds the stamina cost after a successful hit.
texts.SkillMechanicsUltDesc: Creates a turret usable by any player with 120 rounds of ammunition. Has 30% of your maximum HP. DPS scales by rank based on best base weapon DPS and may overheat during sustained fire. Disappears after 900 s or when ammunition is depleted. Only one personal turret may exist at a time; creating a new one removes the oldest. Since 0.7.0.1, damage uses the highest base DPS across primary and secondary weapons; weapon-specific bonuses such as backstab, critical damage and weapon identity damage do not apply.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsP1Desc: Increases the chance of additional loot when harvesting with crowbars.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsP2Desc: Increases gathering speed when harvesting with crowbars.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsP3Desc: Reduces durability loss when harvesting with crowbars.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsP4Desc: Increases stamina regeneration while inside buildings.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsP5Desc: If more than 10 s have passed since the last ability used: reduces stamina cost and cooldown of the next ability used.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsT1Desc: Single-target melee attack. Deals no damage, neutralizes the target, and applies Crippled for an initial 2 s. Base cost: 65 AP (stamina); base cooldown: 50 s.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsT1EffectiveDesc: Single-target melee attack. Deals no damage, neutralizes the target, and applies Crippled for an initial {effect0} s. Base cost: 65 AP (stamina); base cooldown: 50 s.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsT1Way1Desc: Hits all targets within melee range.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsT2Desc: Grants +0.5% damage for each percent of HP missing, for 15 s.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsT2EffectiveDesc: Grants +0.5% damage for each percent of HP missing, for {effect0} s.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsT2Way1Desc: Additionally grants +0.5% critical chance for each percent of HP missing.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsT2Way2Desc: Additionally grants +0.5% critical damage for each percent of HP missing.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsT3Desc: Requires an active melee weapon. Attack against all nearby targets: deals 400% active weapon DPS; hits apply Vulnerable for 4 s.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsT3EffectiveDesc: Requires an active melee weapon. Attack against all nearby targets: deals {effect0}% active weapon DPS; hits apply Vulnerable for 4 s.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsT3ImpactDesc: Improves damage based on active weapon DPS.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsT3Way1Desc: On hit, gain Haste for 5 s.
texts.SkillStreetSmartsT3Way2Desc: Extends Vulnerable by 4 s (base 4 s, total 8 s).
texts.SkillStreetSmartsUltDesc: Attack against all nearby targets. Damage is based on the highest DPS value of your primary and secondary weapon. Hits neutralize the target and apply Stunned. Neutralized removes all status effects and interrupts ability channeling. Since 0.7.0.1, damage uses the highest base DPS across primary and secondary weapons; weapon-specific bonuses such as backstab, critical damage and weapon identity damage do not apply.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorP1Desc: Reduces durability loss of flexible armor based on rank and the number of flexible pieces worn. A dash in the original indicates no listed effect.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorP2Desc: On hit: grants a status effect for 4 s, stacking up to ten times. Increases dodge rating based on rank and the number of flexible pieces worn. The values shown are rating points, not percentage points of dodge chance.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorP3Desc: Increases dodge rating based on rank and the number of flexible pieces worn. Do not automatically equate percentage rating changes with percentage points of dodge chance.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorP4Desc: Requires at least four flexible pieces. If HP falls below 20% after taking damage: gain 50 stamina, reduce all active cooldowns by 10 s, and gain increased dodge according to the table for 5 s. Can trigger at most once every 60 s.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorP5Desc: Increases damage reduction rating based on rank and the number of flexible pieces worn. Rating changes should not automatically be interpreted as direct damage reduction.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorP6Desc: Chance to block mental debuffs, based on rank and the number of flexible pieces worn.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorT1Desc: Gain a shield for an initial 5 s equal to a portion of your maximum HP, based on the number of flexible pieces worn. If the shield is depleted by an enemy attack, you gain increased damage according to the second table for 5 s. The shield table shows the base value without the additional Vanguard bonus. Base cost: 65 AP; base cooldown: 60 s.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorT1EffectiveDesc: Gain a shield for an initial {effect0} s equal to a portion of your maximum HP, based on the number of flexible pieces worn. If the shield is depleted by an enemy attack, you gain increased damage according to the second table for 5 s. The shield table shows the base value without the additional Vanguard bonus. Base cost: 65 AP; base cooldown: 60 s.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorT2Desc: Blocks the next incoming mental or physical debuff. The base duration depends on the number of flexible pieces worn. After one block, the barrier is consumed.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorT2EffectiveDesc: Blocks the next incoming mental or physical debuff. The base duration depends on the number of flexible pieces worn. After one block, the barrier is consumed. Status effect duration: {effect0} s.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorT2Way1Desc: Can block two additional mental debuffs.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorT2Way2Desc: Can block two additional physical debuffs.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorT3Desc: Grants +10% dodge and +30% damage. Base duration depends on the number of flexible pieces worn according to the table. Afterwards, a follow-up effect applies −20% dodge; its displayed duration with seven pieces is 13 s.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorT3EffectiveDesc: Grants +{effect0}% dodge and +30% damage. Base duration depends on the number of flexible pieces worn according to the table. Afterwards, a follow-up effect applies −20% dodge; its displayed duration with seven pieces is 13 s.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorT3Way2Desc: The follow-up effect does not occur.
texts.SkillFlexibleArmorUltDesc: Requires seven flexible armor pieces. Removes all physical and mental debuffs. During the status effect, blocks all incoming physical and mental debuffs and grants 100% dodge. Also dodges abilities that would normally ignore dodge. Can be used even when affected by a debuff that would prevent skill usage.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorP1Desc: Reduces durability loss of sturdy armor based on rank and the number of sturdy pieces worn. A dash indicates no listed effect.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorP2Desc: On hit: grants a status effect for 4 s, stacking up to ten times. Increases damage reduction rating based on rank and number of pieces worn. Table values are rating points, not percentage points of damage reduction.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorP3Desc: Increases damage reduction rating based on rank and number of sturdy pieces worn. Percentage rating changes should not automatically be interpreted as direct damage reduction.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorP4Desc: Requires at least four sturdy pieces. If HP falls below 20% after taking damage: removes all physical and mental debuffs and grants increased damage reduction according to the table for 5 s. Can trigger at most once every 60 s. Can also trigger while affected by a debuff that would prevent skill usage. Values for fewer than four pieces remain documented but do not meet the requirement.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorP5Desc: Increases dodge rating based on rank and the number of sturdy pieces worn. Do not automatically equate it with percentage points of dodge chance.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorP6Desc: Chance to block physical debuffs based on rank and the number of sturdy pieces worn.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorT1Desc: Grants a shield for 5 s equal to a percentage of your maximum HP, based on the number of sturdy pieces worn.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorT1EffectiveDesc: Grants a shield for {effect0} s equal to a percentage of your maximum HP, based on the number of sturdy pieces worn.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorT1ImpactDesc: Improves increased status effect duration according to tooltip.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorT1Way2Desc: Stamina cost is refunded after using the ability.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorT2Desc: Grants a status effect with −50% duration of mental and physical debuffs. Base duration depends on the number of sturdy armor pieces worn according to the table.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorT2EffectiveDesc: Grants a status effect with −50% duration of mental and physical debuffs. Base duration depends on the number of sturdy armor pieces worn according to the table. Increased status effect duration according to tooltip: {effect0} s.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorT2ImpactDesc: Improves increased status effect duration according to tooltip.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorT3Desc: Grants +10% damage reduction and +100% stamina regeneration. Base duration depends on the number of sturdy armor pieces worn according to the table. Afterwards, a follow-up effect applies −20% damage reduction; displayed follow-up duration with seven pieces: 13 s.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorT3EffectiveDesc: Grants +{effect0}% damage reduction and +100% stamina regeneration. Base duration depends on the number of sturdy armor pieces worn according to the table. Afterwards, a follow-up effect applies −20% damage reduction; displayed follow-up duration with seven pieces: 13 s.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorT3Way2Desc: The follow-up effect does not occur.
texts.SkillSturdyArmorUltDesc: Requires seven sturdy armor pieces. Removes all physical and mental debuffs. During the status effect, blocks all incoming physical and mental debuffs and reflects the status effects back to their source. Can also be used while affected by a debuff that would prevent skill usage.
texts.SkillEnduranceP1Desc: Increases stamina by 3 per rank, up to 45 at rank 15.
texts.SkillEnduranceP2Desc: Increases stamina regeneration while sitting or standing.
texts.SkillEnduranceP3Desc: Increases the height you can fall without taking damage.
texts.SkillEnduranceP4Desc: Reduces stamina costs while sprinting or jumping.
texts.SkillEnduranceT1Desc: Grants a status effect for an initial 8 s: sprinting costs no stamina. Base cost: 20 stamina; base cooldown: 35 s.
texts.SkillEnduranceT1EffectiveDesc: Grants a status effect for an initial {effect0} s: sprinting costs no stamina. Base cost: 20 stamina; base cooldown: 35 s.
texts.SkillEnduranceT1Way1Desc: Extends the status effect by 5 s.
texts.SkillEnduranceT1Way2Desc: During the status effect, stamina also regenerates while sprinting.
texts.SkillEnduranceT2Desc: You and group members within 20 m gain Haste for 5 s.
texts.SkillEnduranceT2EffectiveDesc: You and group members within 20 m gain Haste for {effect0} s.
texts.SkillEnduranceT2Way1Desc: Increases the Haste duration on yourself by 15 s.
texts.SkillEnduranceT2Way2Desc: Increases the Haste duration on yourself and group members by 10 s.
texts.SkillEnduranceT3Desc: Grants +50 maximum stamina for 5 s and instantly restores 50 stamina.
texts.SkillEnduranceT3EffectiveDesc: Grants +{effect0} maximum stamina for 5 s and instantly restores {effect1} stamina.
texts.SkillEnduranceT3ImpactDesc: Increases both maximum stamina and the amount of stamina restored instantly.
texts.SkillEnduranceT3Way1Desc: Additionally grants +25 maximum stamina and instantly restores an additional 25 stamina.
texts.SkillEnduranceT3Way2Desc: Ignores all negative movement speed effects caused by movement-reducing debuffs.
texts.SkillEnduranceUltDesc: Grants a status effect providing increased regeneration depending on rank (see rank values). Cannot be neutralized. The tooltip does not explain the exact calculation basis of the regeneration.
texts.SkillFirstAidP2Desc: Increases the application speed of medical consumables.
texts.SkillFirstAidP4Desc: Chance to double the effect of medical consumables.
texts.SkillFirstAidT1Desc: Grants a 5% chance to block debuffs for 30 s.
texts.SkillFirstAidT1EffectiveDesc: Grants a {effect0}% chance to block debuffs for 30 s.
texts.SkillFirstAidT1Way1Desc: When a debuff is blocked, 10% of maximum HP is restored.
texts.SkillFirstAidT1Way2Desc: When a debuff is blocked, 10 stamina is restored.
texts.SkillFirstAidT2Desc: Grants you and group members +5% damage for 20 s.
texts.SkillFirstAidT2EffectiveDesc: Grants you and group members +{effect0}% damage for 20 s.
texts.SkillFirstAidT2Way1Desc: Extends the status effect by 15 s.
texts.SkillFirstAidT3Desc: Removes all physical debuffs, heals 20% of maximum HP, and grants +5% regeneration for 10 s. The tooltip does not explain the calculation basis of the regeneration.
texts.SkillFirstAidT3EffectiveDesc: Removes all physical debuffs, heals {effect0}% of maximum HP, and grants +5% regeneration for 10 s. The tooltip does not explain the calculation basis of the regeneration.
texts.SkillFirstAidT3ImpactDesc: Improves healing based on maximum HP.
texts.SkillFirstAidT3Way1Desc: The skill also affects all group members.
texts.SkillFirstAidT3Way2Desc: Also removes all mental debuffs. Can be used even while affected by debuffs that would normally prevent skill use.
texts.SkillFirstAidUltDesc: Revives a dead player within melee range who does not have the Revived status effect. Restores HP and stamina proportionally to their respective maximum values and grants the target the non-removable Revived status for 300 s.
texts.SpecialAutoReloadDesc: Automatically reloads while firing when the magazine becomes empty. −50% reload time for automatic reloads.
texts.SpecialBackstabDesc: +75% backstab damage with knives while outside the target’s line of sight. The stat explanation requires hitting the target in the back. Backstab damage increases combine into a damage multiplier. Whether the line-of-sight and behind-target conditions are equivalent remains unconfirmed.
texts.SpecialExecutionerDesc: 100% critical chance when the target is below 20% HP. Skills can improve this special; this is the base value.
texts.SpecialHiddenDesc: Targets cannot identify the direction from which this weapon hit them.
texts.SpecialKnockbackDesc: Hits with this weapon knock NPCs back. This weapon special is separate from the recoil stat removed in 0.7.0.0.
texts.SpecialMomentumDesc: Up to +10% dodge, depending on the percentage of stamina remaining. Example: +4% dodge at 40% stamina.
texts.SpecialNoSpecialDesc: Burst fire was removed as a weapon identity in 0.7.0.0. A replacement special is planned for a future update.
texts.SpecialPenetratingDesc: Bullets penetrate up to X targets and deal 25% penetration damage after the first target. The game describes penetration damage as the sum of all penetration damage increases; the damage reference remains unconfirmed. Read X on the weapon: FN Minimi and M249 were confirmed with X = 3; a universal default has not been established.
texts.SpecialRageDesc: Each hit fills the rage meter, up to 100%. Rage resets after 4 s without a hit. Depending on rage, grants up to +20% movement speed, +15% attack speed and +15% damage reduction.
texts.SpecialRiposteDesc: Dodging a melee attack deals 25% riposte damage to all targets in melee range. The game describes riposte damage as the sum of all riposte damage increases. The damage reference and interaction with general DPS buffs remain unconfirmed.
texts.SpecialScopeDesc: This weapon has a scope. Magnification depends on the weapon: Mk 14 EBR ×2, SVD ×3.
texts.SpecialSpreadDesc: Each shot consists of multiple projectiles that spread in a cone.
texts.SpecialStackingHitsDesc: Each hit grants +20% stacking damage for subsequent hits, stacking with every hit. Stacks reset on a miss, reload or after 5 s without a hit. The game states that stacking damage increases combine into a damage multiplier applied on hits with an active revolver.
texts.SpecialSwayDesc: Moving forward grants +40% pivoting damage. Moving backward grants +25% dodge rating and damage reduction rating. The game states that pivoting damage increases combine into a damage multiplier applied only while moving forward with a pistol.
texts.MetricActiveWeaponDamage: Damage based on active weapon DPS
texts.MetricBestWeaponDamage: Damage based on best base weapon DPS
texts.MetricBestWeaponDpsPerTick: Best Base Weapon DPS per Second
texts.MetricBonusActiveWeaponDamage: Additional damage based on active weapon DPS
texts.MetricEvasionDuringBuff: Evade while under a status effect
texts.MetricPulseHealing: Healing based on maximum HP per pulse
texts.MetricShieldBreakDamage: Damage bonus after enemy shield break
texts.MetricShieldHpRatio: Shield based on own maximum HP
texts.MetricSprintJumpCostReduction: Reduced stamina cost while sprinting or jumping
texts.MetricTooltipEffectDuration: Increased status effect duration according to tooltip
texts.MetricTurretDps: Turret DPS based on best base weapon DPS
texts.MetricUnseenCritDamage: Critical damage outside line of sight
texts.EffectBlinded: Players: the screen turns white, obscuring vision. Non-player targets do not attack.
texts.EffectDazedControls: Players: movement keys randomly swapped. Non-player targets run away in a random direction.
texts.EffectIncomingDamageReduction: Reduction of incoming damage from attacks and abilities.
texts.EffectOutgoingDamagePenalty: The target deals −80 % damage from all sources except damage-over-time effects.
texts.EffectTargetHpDamage: 2% of the target's maximum health as damage per second.
texts.EffectTraumatized: Players: both mouse axes inverted. Non-player targets run away in random directions.
texts.EffectiveTooltipDurationNote: Additional duration stated in the tooltip.
texts.GlossaryAggroDesc: The priority that determines which target a non-player unit attacks next.
texts.GlossaryBleedingDesc: Deals damage equal to 2 % of the target's maximum HP per second. Does not stack; reapplication refreshes the duration. Bleeding bypasses shields.
texts.GlossaryDisarmedDesc: Players cannot use weapons. Non-player targets do not attack.
texts.GlossaryMoveSpeedDesc: The speed at which you move.
texts.GlossaryNpcDesc: Any unit that is not a player, such as zombies and NPCs.
texts.GlossaryPacifiedDesc: Removes you from a non-player target's aggro list.
texts.GlossarySlowingDebuffsDesc: Crippled, Slowed and Suppressed count as movement-reducing debuffs.
texts.GlossaryStunnedDesc: The target cannot move, attack, use items or use abilities.
texts.GlossaryTauntDesc: Places the taunting entity at the top of a non-player target's aggro list.
texts.ConditionDebuffExpires: One of your own debuffs expires; active removal by another skill does not count
texts.ConditionDoubleTap: Double-press movement keys in one direction
texts.ConditionPhysicalDebuff: Active physical debuff on the user
texts.ConditionRangedUnseen: Active ranged weapon; outside the target's line of sight
texts.ConditionSkillIdle: Last ability used more than 10 s ago
texts.TargetConsumableBuffs: Positive effects gained from consumable items.
texts.TargetHpDamage: Damage based on target's maximum HP
texts.TargetHpHealing: Healing based on target's maximum HP
texts.TargetNpc: Any unit that is not a player, such as zombies or NPCs.
texts.NoteUnboundDebuffList: Crippled, Slowed and Suppressed according to the extended Unbound tooltip.
texts.RuleBestWeaponDps: Highest base weapon DPS across primary and secondary weapons (0.7.0.1)
texts.RuleDebuffImmunity: After suffering a debuff, there is immunity against further instances of the same debuff for several seconds. Duration not specified.
texts.RuleRoundUpSeconds: Round up to the next whole second
texts.RuleTriggeredEffects: All effects that occur during a status triggered by a skill.
texts.RuleWayPointCounting: ODS requires the base point plus at least ten enhancer points and counts the Way itself as an additional point.
texts.RuleWayUnlock: 11 points in the skill tree before the choice; then 1 point for the Way. Ways can be swapped in the planner but are permanent in-game.
texts.HintCommunityPlanner: Unofficial community planner. Game values and rules may change during development.
texts.PlanExperienceNote: Badge and perk requirements for the whole plan. Tree XP must also be earned.
texts.PlanPerks: {count} perk points for the entire plan
texts.PlanTooManyUltimates: The plan requires more than five Ultimate badges; confirmed awards are at 45, 55, 65, 75 and 85.
texts.SourceSharedBaseValues: Shared base values of active skills
texts.TreeConfusedDesc: Prevents the use of active abilities.
texts.TreeCrippledDesc: −40% movement speed and −20% damage dealt with all attacks and abilities.
texts.TreeFishingDesc: Cost and cooldown on activation. Effect ends when consumed, expired, upon weapon swap, or when replaced by another next-hit ability. Can be used again no earlier than 10 s after ending, provided the regular cooldown has finished.
texts.TreeNeutralizedDesc: Removes status effects and interrupts ongoing skill channeling.
texts.TreePoisonedDesc: Deals damage relative to the target's maximum HP.
texts.TreeSlowedDesc: −60% movement speed; does not fully immobilize.
texts.TreeTraumatizedDesc: Players: both mouse axes are inverted. Non-player targets run away in random directions.
